logic: Use viable frozen LTEE material whose evolutionary history is already fixed, while generating the registered MIC outcome only after public preregistration. This avoids waiting for a new long evolution experiment while preserving prospective outcome timing.
candidate_material_rule: Prefer LTEE populations/timepoints not used in the Donofrio dataset. Exact material remains ineligible until a metadata-only audit confirms that the registered target MIC values for that exact candidate have not been opened by ORI-C and the measuring team is independent.

official_archive_basis.fact: LTEE populations are cryo-archived every 500 generations and remain viable for revival

official_protocol_basis.fact: LTEE experimental protocols and resources are publicly documented

candidate_independent_labs.name: MICA Lab
candidate_independent_labs.current_fit_evidence: official lab research includes antimicrobial resistance and experimental evolution; platform open to academic partners

candidate_independent_labs.name: Laboratory of Pharmaceutical Microbiology
candidate_independent_labs.current_fit_evidence: official Ghent staff page documents experimental evolution focused on reduced antibiotic susceptibility

eligibility_gates: material identity fixed before outcome measurement
exact target MIC values not previously opened by ORI-C
analysis and success rule publicly registered before measurements
group/history identifiers fixed before MIC acquisition
raw MIC table hash frozen before ORI-C decoding
strict_success_rule_inherited: gain >= 5 %, bootstrap interval of gain > 0, permutation p <= 0.05

A_strict_replication.design: Use LTEE founder histories not used in the original benchmark, reproduce a predeclared downstream evolution/treatment design sufficiently close to the frozen D'Onofrio relation, then measure new MIC outcomes after public registration.
A_strict_replication.cost: requires new biological propagation before MIC

purpose: potential XIV-3/4 branch progress after eligibility audit
B_fast_prospective_generalisation.design: Select archived LTEE histories using metadata only and generate new MIC outcomes after public registration under a common standardized assay, without replaying the 1000-generation C/N step.
B_fast_prospective_generalisation.advantage: much faster because history is already physically archived
B_fast_prospective_generalisation.limit: must not be called a strict D'Onofrio replication for XIV-10 unless the independent replication audit explicitly accepts the construct match before outcomes
